name: CareTria (formerly Knipper Health)
desc:
Patient Support Representative | $17/hr | Inbound and Outbound Pharmacy Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: CareTria (formerly Knipper Health)
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
CareTria runs patient support programs for pharmacies and drug makers. In this role, you're the phone and email contact for patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers using a pharmacy program. You'll answer inbound calls and emails, return voicemails with outbound calls, and keep the system updated with every detail. You'll give patients shipping and tracking updates on their medication, answer questions about the program, and try to solve issues on the first call. If you can't, you'll look into it and follow up until it's fixed, or escalate it. You'll also report any side effects or product complaints that come up, following set procedures. Program rules change often, so being flexible and organized matters.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and compassion
- Clear, friendly phone manner
- Organization and attention to detail
- Flexibility when rules change
- Tact with upset callers
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: 2 years in a customer service or customer-focused role, with a record of high-quality service
Preferred Experience: Associate degree or technical training, 1 year in pharmacy, managed care, Medicaid or Medicare, pharma or biotech, insurance, or a medical office, HIPAA and patient services experience, and bilingual English and Spanish

Required Skills:
- Excellent verbal and written communication
- Organized and detail-oriented
- Balancing several priorities and deadlines
- Adaptable when things change
- Basic math and logical thinking
- Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
- Works well alone and on a team
- Outgoing and enjoys talking with people

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has 2+ years of customer service, especially in a call center
- Has worked in a pharmacy, doctor's office, or insurance
- Speaks Spanish as well as English
- Likes following up until a problem is fully solved

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 2 years of customer service experience
- Gets frustrated when rules and procedures change often
- Doesn't want to make outbound calls
- Struggles to type notes while on a call
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
5. Complete CareTria's pre-employment screening:
- Work authorization: I-9 and E-Verify
- Education verification with your highest level of school
- 7-year criminal background check (federal and state)
- 7-year employment verification with past employers
- Drug screen at a testing site within 3 days of the offer
Steps 1 to 4 are an estimated process. Step 5 comes directly from CareTria.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Patient support
- Pharmacy customer service
- Inbound and outbound calls
- First call resolution
- Medication shipping and tracking
- Adverse event reporting
- HIPAA compliance
- Healthcare provider support
- Issue resolution and escalation
- Bilingual Spanish

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service experience and the types of calls you've handled.
- A patient calls upset that their medication hasn't arrived. What do you do?
- How do you stay organized when you're handling calls, emails, and voicemails at the same time?
- Tell us about a time you followed up on a problem until it was fully solved. What was the problem, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time rules or procedures changed at work. What changed, how did you adjust, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $17/hr, with possible performance bonuses for eligible employees.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage. (An earlier CareTria posting for a similar role listed Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Central, so ask if that still applies.)
-Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plan options, PTO, paid parental leave, and employee assistance programs.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: 7-year federal and state criminal background check. Yes, 7 years+, per our current listing.
-Drug Test: Required. Drug screen at a testing site within 3 days of the offer.
-Notes: This is a full-time role with real benefits and a pay bump from CareTria's earlier posting. It's a good fit for a participant with 2 years of customer service who wants to move into healthcare. Bilingual English and Spanish is a plus. Pre-employment screening includes I-9 and E-Verify, education verification, a 7-year background check, 7-year employment verification, and a drug screen. The posting lists some physical demands like occasional lifting up to 25 pounds, which is unusual for a remote role, so participants can ask about it. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Patient Support Representative → Senior Patient Support Representative → Team Lead → Patient Services Supervisor → Program Operations Manager. This role builds pharmacy, patient services, and healthcare compliance skills.
